nodes.description: Access-control role identifier granting owner privileges (upgrade, swapper, role admin).
Access-control role for manager operations such as pausing and setting fee receivers.
Access-control role for staff operations such as fee collection and gas limits.
Access-control role authorised to complete deposits and withdrawals.
Upper bound of the deposit/withdraw yield-rate ratio check.
Lower bound of the deposit/withdraw yield-rate ratio check.
Trusted swapper contract address; also the msg.sender gate for onlySwapper.
Recipient address for collected gas fees.
ERC20 (or ETHER_ADDRESS sentinel) token users deposit and receive on withdrawal.
Decimals of the deposit token, used for yield-rate scaling arithmetic.
XYToken wrapper minted on completed deposits and burned on withdrawals.
External oracle contract queried for the latest gas price.
Gas limit used to compute deposit gas fees.
Gas limit used to compute withdrawal gas fees.
Accumulated gas fees collected from deposit/withdraw calls.
Accumulated gas fees owed for the swapper to close swaps.
Counter and id space for deposit requests.
Counter and id space for withdrawal requests.
Mapping of deposit id to DepositRequest (amount, sender, isComplete).
Mapping of withdrawal id to WithdrawalRequest (amount, sender, isComplete).
Caller-controlled address used in role checks, refunds, token pulls and request records.
Proxy initializer setting token addresses, decimals and all role admins/members.
Modifier requiring msg.sender == swapper.
UUPS upgrade authorisation hook restricted to ROLE_OWNER.
Reads latest gas price from the external gasPriceConsumer contract.
Sends ETH or ERC20 tokens to a receiver, choosing the branch from the token address.
Pulls ERC20 tokens with safeTransferFrom and verifies the received balance delta.
Zeroes depositAndWithdrawFees then transfers them to the receiver.
Zeroes closeSwapGasFees then transfers them as ETH or depositToken.
Owner-only setter of the trusted swapper contract address.
Manager-only setter of the gas fee receiver address.
Manager-only setter of the external gas price consumer contract.
Staff-only setter of the deposit gas limit.
Manager-only setter of the min/max yield rate bounds.
Staff-only setter of the withdrawal gas limit.
Swapper-only transfer of deposit tokens to the swapper contract.
Payable entry point creating a deposit request, taking a gas fee and pulling tokens.
Liquidity-worker function validating the yield rate and minting wrapped tokens.
Payable entry point creating a withdrawal request and pulling wrapped tokens.
Liquidity-worker function validating the yield rate, burning wrapped tokens and paying out.
Staff-only wrapper that sweeps deposit/withdraw gas fees.
Staff-only wrapper that sweeps close-swap gas fees.
Staff-only wrapper sweeping both fee pools.
Swapper-only payable entry receiving returned assets and accruing close-swap gas fees.
Manager-only pause switch.
Manager-only unpause switch.
Plain ETH receive hook with no accounting.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(msg.value - requiredValue) refund in deposit.
payable(msg.sender).transfer(msg.value - gasFee) refund in withdraw.
payable(receiver).transfer of accumulated deposit/withdraw fees.
ETH transfer or depositToken.safeTransfer of accumulated close-swap fees.
External ETH transfer or ERC20 safeTransfer inside _safeTransferAsset.
External ERC20 safeTransferFrom pulling user/swapper funds inside _safeTransferAssetFrom.
xyWrappedToken.mint external call during completeDeposit.
xyWrappedToken.burn external call during completeWithdraw.
Multiplication/exponentiation/division used to compute the deposit yield rate.
Multiplication/exponentiation/division used to compute the withdrawal yield rate.
External call to IGasPriceConsumer.getLatestGasPrice().
Amount of deposit token requested in deposit(uint256 amount).
Gas fee computed as completeDepositGasLimit * gas price in deposit.
msg.value required for deposit, computed from gasFee and amount.
New deposit request id taken from numDeposits++.
Deposit request identifier passed to completeDeposit.
Amount of wrapped tokens to mint in completeDeposit.
Storage pointer to the DepositRequest being completed.
Amount of wrapped tokens to withdraw in withdraw.
Gas fee computed as completeWithdrawGasLimit * gas price in withdraw.
New withdrawal request id taken from numWithdrawals++.
Withdrawal request identifier passed to completeWithdraw.
Payout amount of deposit token in completeWithdraw.
Withdrawal fee added to amount for the yield-rate check.
Storage pointer to the WithdrawalRequest being completed.
New maximum yield rate bound parameter.
New minimum yield rate bound parameter.
Balance delta used to verify the amount actually received.
New swapper contract address parameter.
Token address parameter checked against depositToken.
Cached fee amount zeroed before being transferred out.
Cached close-swap fee amount zeroed before being transferred out.
Receiver address for collected deposit/withdraw gas fees.

edges.reason: deposit reads completeDepositGasLimit to compute the gas fee.
deposit accumulates depositAndWithdrawFees before storing the request.
deposit increments numDeposits to obtain the new request id.
deposit writes a new DepositRequest into depositRequests.
deposit checks depositToken against ETHER_ADDRESS and pulls that token.
completeDeposit reads and mutates the DepositRequest entry.
completeDeposit compares the computed yield rate to maxYieldRateBound.
completeDeposit compares the computed yield rate to minYieldRateBound.
completeDeposit uses depositTokenDecimal for yield-rate scaling.
completeDeposit mints via the xyWrappedToken contract.
completeDeposit validates _depositID against numDeposits.
withdraw reads completeWithdrawGasLimit to compute the gas fee.
withdraw accumulates depositAndWithdrawFees.
withdraw increments numWithdrawals to obtain the new request id.
withdraw writes a new WithdrawalRequest into withdrawalRequests.
withdraw pulls xyWrappedToken from the caller.
completeWithdraw reads and mutates the WithdrawalRequest entry.
completeWithdraw compares the yield rate to maxYieldRateBound.
completeWithdraw compares the yield rate to minYieldRateBound.
completeWithdraw pays out the deposit token to the requester.
completeWithdraw uses depositTokenDecimal for yield-rate scaling.
completeWithdraw burns the wrapped token via xyWrappedToken.
completeWithdraw validates _withdrawID against numWithdrawals.
_getGasPrice reads the configured gasPriceConsumer address.
_collectDepositAndWithdrawGasFees reads and zeroes depositAndWithdrawFees.
_collectCloseSwapGasFees reads and zeroes closeSwapGasFees.
_collectCloseSwapGasFees branches on depositToken being ETHER_ADDRESS.
setSwapper writes the swapper state variable.
setGasFeeReceiver writes the gasFeeReceiver state variable.
setGasPriceConsumer writes the gasPriceConsumer state variable.
setCompleteDepositGasLimit writes completeDepositGasLimit.
setYieldRateBound writes maxYieldRateBound.
setYieldRateBound writes minYieldRateBound.
setCompleteWithdrawGasLimit writes completeWithdrawGasLimit.
transferToSwapper requires token == depositToken.
receiveAssetFromSwapper requires token == depositToken.
receiveAssetFromSwapper increases closeSwapGasFees.
collectDepositAndWithdrawGasFees forwards the gasFeeReceiver.
collectCloseSwapGasFees forwards the gasFeeReceiver.
collectFees forwards the gasFeeReceiver to both helpers.
deposit calls _getGasPrice to price the gas fee.
deposit calls _safeTransferAssetFrom which performs an external transferFrom.
withdraw calls _getGasPrice to price the gas fee.
withdraw calls _safeTransferAssetFrom on the wrapped token.
transferToSwapper calls _safeTransferAsset for the external transfer.
completeWithdraw calls _safeTransferAsset to pay the requester.
receiveAssetFromSwapper calls _safeTransferAssetFrom to pull assets from the swapper.
collectDepositAndWithdrawGasFees invokes the private fee helper.
collectCloseSwapGasFees invokes the private fee helper.
collectFees invokes _collectDepositAndWithdrawGasFees.
collectFees invokes _collectCloseSwapGasFees.
initialize sets the admin and grants ROLE_OWNER.
initialize grants ROLE_MANAGER.
initialize grants ROLE_STAFF.
initialize grants ROLE_LIQUIDITY_WORKER.
_authorizeUpgrade is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_OWNER).
setSwapper is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_OWNER).
setGasFeeReceiver is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_MANAGER).
setGasPriceConsumer is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_MANAGER).
setYieldRateBound is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_MANAGER).
setCompleteDepositGasLimit is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_STAFF).
setCompleteWithdrawGasLimit is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_STAFF).
collectDepositAndWithdrawGasFees is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_STAFF).
collectCloseSwapGasFees is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_STAFF).
collectFees is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_STAFF).
completeDeposit is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_LIQUIDITY_WORKER).
completeWithdraw is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_LIQUIDITY_WORKER).
pause is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_MANAGER).
unpause is restricted by onlyRole(ROLE_MANAGER).
transferToSwapper is guarded by the onlySwapper modifier.
receiveAssetFromSwapper is guarded by the onlySwapper modifier.
onlySwapper reads the swapper state variable for the comparison.
onlySwapper reads msg.sender and compares it to swapper.
deposit uses msg.sender as the refund recipient and token-pull source.
withdraw uses msg.sender as the refund recipient and token-pull source.
deposit performs an ETH refund transfer to msg.sender.
withdraw performs an ETH refund transfer to msg.sender.
_collectDepositAndWithdrawGasFees sends ETH to the receiver.
_collectCloseSwapGasFees sends ETH or depositToken to the receiver.
_safeTransferAsset performs an external ETH/ERC20 transfer.
_safeTransferAssetFrom performs an external ERC20 transferFrom.
completeDeposit calls the external xyWrappedToken.mint.
completeWithdraw calls the external xyWrappedToken.burn.
_getGasPrice calls the external gas price oracle.
completeDeposit computes amountDepositToken * 10**decimals / amountXYWrappedToken.
completeWithdraw computes (amount + withdrawFee) * 10**decimals / amountXYWrappedToken.
deposit yield-rate arithmetic scales by depositTokenDecimal.
deposit yield-rate arithmetic is bounded by maxYieldRateBound.
deposit yield-rate arithmetic is bounded by minYieldRateBound.
withdraw yield-rate arithmetic scales by depositTokenDecimal.
withdraw yield-rate arithmetic is bounded by maxYieldRateBound.
withdraw yield-rate arithmetic is bounded by minYieldRateBound.
fee collection zeroes depositAndWithdrawFees before transferring.
close-swap fee collection zeroes closeSwapGasFees before transferring.
amount parameter flows into deposit request creation.
local gasFee drives the msg.value requirement in deposit.
local requiredValue drives the msg.value check and refund in deposit.
local id indexes the new depositRequests entry.
_depositID parameter indexes depositRequests in completeDeposit.
amountXYWrappedToken parameter determines the minted amount.
request storage pointer is mutated during completeDeposit.
amountXYWrappedToken parameter is stored in the withdrawal request.
local gasFee drives the msg.value requirement in withdraw.
local id indexes the new withdrawalRequests entry.
_withdrawID parameter indexes withdrawalRequests in completeWithdraw.
amount parameter is the payout amount in completeWithdraw.
withdrawFee parameter feeds the yield-rate check in completeWithdraw.
request storage pointer is mutated during completeWithdraw.
_maxYieldRateBound parameter is written to state.
_minYieldRateBound parameter is written to state.
local bal verifies the amount received in _safeTransferAssetFrom.
_swapper parameter is written to the swapper state variable.
token parameter is checked against depositToken in receiveAssetFromSwapper.
cached fee amount is zeroed and transferred in the fee helper.
cached close-swap fee amount is zeroed and transferred in the fee helper.
receiver parameter is the ETH transfer destination in the fee helper.

local gasFee computation belongs to the deposit function body.
local requiredValue computation belongs to the deposit function body.
local deposit id is produced by the deposit function.

amountXYWrappedToken parameter is only used by completeDeposit.
request storage pointer is local to completeDeposit.
amountXYWrappedToken parameter is only used by withdraw.
local gasFee computation belongs to the withdraw function body.
local withdrawal id is produced by the withdraw function.
_withdrawID parameter is only used by completeWithdraw.
amount parameter is only used by completeWithdraw.
withdrawFee parameter is only used by completeWithdraw.
request storage pointer is local to completeWithdraw.
_maxYieldRateBound parameter is only used by setYieldRateBound.
_minYieldRateBound parameter is only used by setYieldRateBound.

_swapper parameter is only used by setSwapper.
token parameter is only used by receiveAssetFromSwapper.

cached fee local variable is only used by _collectCloseSwapGasFees.
